the online problem is not harder to solve than the off-line problem, in the worst case, and that the online problem can be solved faster, on average, by a randomized algorithm.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we can solve the 3-d online programming problem in the same time as the 2-d online linear programming problem and that we can solve 2-d convex programs in the same time that 2-d online programs are solved by randomized algorithms.
we can solve the following two problems in the same asymptotic worst-case time: the 2-d convex program with linear objective function and the 3-d on-line linear programming problem.

we can solve two-dimensional convex programs and the three-dimensional online linear programming problem in near-optimal time, and that we can solve the convex hull of a set ofn2-dimensional convex polygons inO(n2logn) worst-case-time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the online programming problem in the plane can be solved efficiently in a deterministic manner.
, in the plane, convex programming is no more complex than linear programming, and in three dimensions, the online linear programming problem is no harder than the offline version.

, despite the fact that convex programs are inherently non-linear and that online programming problems are inherently non-convex, it is possible to design deterministic algorithms that are as good as the best randomized algorithms.
